notes: HST is a joint Harvard-MIT graduate program, not itself a department with independent labs -- its 'Faculty List' is an alphabetical, keyword-searchable directory of several hundred affiliated faculty whose primary labs are based at MIT departments/institutes (CSAIL, IDSS, IMES, Koch, McGovern, RLE, Wyss) or Harvard-affiliated hospitals (MGH, BIDMC, Brigham and Women's, Boston Children's, Dana-Farber, Joslin, MEEI, Ragon, Whitehead, Broad). Recording all of them here would duplicate labs that belong in each home department/institute's own source file, so this file is deliberately empty per the project's cross-cutting-hub convention. No single HST-wide PI or contact to record.
